name: 30888-longdecode-qwen330ba3b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 -- four GPUs of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4).
parallelism: TP=1, DP=4, expert parallel on so ep_size = 4, expert-parallel load balancing on; one vLLM engine, four data-parallel engine cores on one node.
architecture: Sparse-MoE decoder (Qwen3MoeForCausalLM): 48 MoE layers, 128 routed experts at top-8, ~30.5B parameters of which ~3.3B are active per token, block-FP8 weights -- all read off the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1024 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed static 30888.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`: 1024 prompt tokens and 1024 output tokens per request, min == max == mean on both, temperature 0, `ignore_eos: true`, prefix caching off.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant generating full-page responses for 256 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine command line. Every key below is part of the declared operating point.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8

tensor-parallel-size: 1
data-parallel-size: 4
enable-expert-parallel: true

enable-eplb: true
# HAZARD: this structured value must stay on ONE line of JSON. Written as a block mapping its
# entries read as indented continuation lines, the key is dropped, and the engine starts without
# it at rc=0 -- a silent wrong run rather than an error.
eplb-config: {"window_size": 20, "step_interval": 80, "num_redundant_experts": 16, "use_async": true}

max-num-seqs: 256
enable-prefix-caching: false
async-scheduling: true
disable-nccl-for-dp-synchronization: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.8
max-model-len: 4096
dtype: bfloat16
